title: Keep the core task usable under real constraints
description: Choose a service task and a user context, then change the architecture contracts. The task path shows where exclusion or lost work appears.

stages.label: Enter
stages.description: Load the service and reach the first meaningful action.

stages.label: Understand
stages.description: Perceive structure, status, language, and instructions.

stages.label: Act
stages.description: Complete every control without a required input mode.

stages.label: Recover
stages.description: Correct errors or resume after interruption without losing work.

contexts.label: Keyboard only on an unstable mobile link
contexts.description: Pointer input is unavailable and a network interruption can happen during the task.

contexts.label: Screen reader with non-visual status
contexts.description: The source order, labels, focus, and asynchronous updates must expose the same task state.

contexts.label: High stress with limited working memory
contexts.description: The user needs plain instructions, stable choices, and a path back from mistakes.

contexts.label: Right-to-left language and local formats
contexts.description: Direction, names, dates, numbers, and generated messages cannot assume English structure.

scenarios.label: Renew a public benefit
scenarios.description: A multi-step application contains identity, household, and payment details.
scenarios.consequence: Losing or misunderstanding the submission can delay essential support.

scenarios.label: Book a clinic appointment
scenarios.description: The user selects a location and time, then receives a confirmation.
scenarios.consequence: A hidden status update or inaccessible slot picker can produce a missed appointment.

scenarios.label: Recover an account
scenarios.description: A security-sensitive flow verifies identity and changes access credentials.
scenarios.consequence: A broken input path can lock out the account owner or encourage an unsafe workaround.

capabilities.label: Semantic HTML core
capabilities.description: Meaningful source order, native controls, labels, and landmarks work before enhancement.

capabilities.label: Keyboard-equivalent actions
capabilities.description: Every pointer action has an operable keyboard path with predictable order.

capabilities.label: Visible, unobscured focus
capabilities.description: Focused controls remain identifiable and are not hidden behind sticky UI.

capabilities.label: Programmatic status updates
capabilities.description: Loading, validation, and completion changes are announced without moving focus.

capabilities.label: Plain, stable instructions
capabilities.description: Labels explain the action and consequences without relying on memory or jargon.

capabilities.label: Locale-aware data boundary
capabilities.description: Store canonical values while formatting language, direction, names, dates, and numbers at the edge.

capabilities.label: Server-owned validation
capabilities.description: The authoritative rules work without depending on client-side JavaScript.

capabilities.label: Linked error summary
capabilities.description: Errors identify the affected fields, explain correction, and preserve entered values.

capabilities.label: Resumable draft state
capabilities.description: An interruption does not force the user to restart or reconstruct prior answers.

capabilities.label: Bounded core payload
capabilities.description: The essential task ships separately from optional media and client enhancements.
